title: schoenus lacustris
intro: Schoenus lacustris, commonly known as Lacustrine Bog-rush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. It is a perennial aquatic plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Schoenus lacustris also include its use in treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, due to its soothing and anti-inflammatory properties.
